name: concept-crm-video
description: Video promocional 3D de Herramienta Multi-Tenant construido con Remotion sobre los componentes reales de la app

scripts.render:musica: npm run musica && remotion render VideoConMusica out/herramienta-multi-tenant-con-musica.mp4
scripts.musica:montar: npm run musica && remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/herramienta-multi-tenant.mp4 -i public/musica/banda-sonora.wav -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest out/herramienta-multi-tenant-con-musica.mp4
